lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jeeu sadaa mukat hai sahaje rahiaa samaai ||2||
lines.translation: Then, this soul is liberated forever, and it remains absorbed in celestial bliss. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh sa(n)saar upaai kai vas aapanai keetaa ||
lines.translation: God created the Universe, and He keeps it under His power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ganatai prabhoo na paaeeai doojai bharameetaa ||
lines.translation: God cannot be obtained by counting; the mortal wanders in doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai jeevat marai bujh sach sameetaa ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one remains dead while yet alive; understanding Him, he is absorbed in the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade haumai khoeeai har mel mileetaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is eradicated, and one is united in the Lord's Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੀਤਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai kare aap aape vigaseetaa ||4||
lines.translation: He knows everything, and Himself does everything; beholding His Creation, He rejoices. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur siu chit na laaio naam na vasio man aai ||
lines.translation: One who has not focused his consciousness on the True Guru, and into whose mind the Naam does not come

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig ivehaa jeeviaa kiaa jug mahi paaiaa aai ||
lines.translation: cursed is such a life. What has he gained by coming into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa khotee raas hai ek chase mahi paaj lahi jaai ||
lines.translation: Maya is false capital; in an instant, its false covering falls off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਤਨੁ ਸਿਆਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਦਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hathahu chhuRakee tan siaahu hoi badan jaai kumalaai ||
lines.translation: When it slips from his hand, his body turns black, and his face withers away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin satigur siu chit laaiaa tinh sukh vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru - peace comes to abide in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam dhiaavahi ra(n)g siu har naam rahe liv laai ||
lines.translation: They meditate on the Name of the Lord with love; they are lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਜਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur so dhan saupiaa j jee mahi rahiaa samaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru has bestowed upon them the wealth, which remains contained within their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g tisai kau agalaa va(n)nee chaRai chaRaai ||1||
lines.translation: They are imbued with supreme love; its color increases day by day. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਗਨੀ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa hoee naaganee jagat rahee lapataai ||
lines.translation: Maya is a serpent, clinging to the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is kee sevaa jo kare tis hee kau phir khaai ||
lines.translation: Whoever serves her, she ultimately devours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਗਾਰੜੂ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਲਿ ਦਲਿ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh koee gaaraRoo tin mal dal laaee paai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is a snake-charmer; he has trampled her and thrown her down, and crushed her underfoot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak seee ubare j sach rahe liv laai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone are saved, who remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaadhee kare pukaar prabhoo sunaaisee ||
lines.translation: The minstrel cries out, and God hears him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar dheerak hoi pooraa paaisee ||
lines.translation: He is comforted within his mind, and he obtains the Perfect Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa lekh se karam kamaaisee ||
lines.translation: Whatever destiny is pre-ordained by the Lord, those are the deeds he does.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa hovai khasam daiaal taa mahal ghar paaisee ||
lines.translation: When the Lord and Master becomes Merciful, then one obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as his home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਸੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh meraa at vadaa guramukh melaaisee ||5||
lines.translation: That God of mine is so very great; as Gurmukh, I have met Him. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa kaa sahu ek hai sad hee rahai hajoor ||
lines.translation: There is One Lord God of all; He remains ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਈ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na ma(n)naee taa ghar hee a(n)dar door ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if one does not obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then within one's own home, the Lord seems far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam bhee tinhaa manaaisee jinh kau nadar karei ||
lines.translation: They alone obey the Lord's Command, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hukam ma(n)n sukh paaiaa prem suhaagan hoi ||1||
lines.translation: Obeying His Command, one obtains peace, and becomes the happy, loving soul-bride. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain sabaaee jal muee ka(n)t na laaio bhaau ||
lines.translation: She who does not love her Husband Lord, burns and wastes away all through the night of her life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh vasan souhaaganee jinh piaaraa purakh har raau ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-brides dwell in peace; they have the Lord, their King, as their Husband. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag phir mai dekhiaa har iko daataa ||
lines.translation: Roaming over the entire world, I have seen that the Lord is the only Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: upaai kitai na paaeeai har karam bidhaataa ||
lines.translation: The Lord cannot be obtained by any device at all; He is the Architect of Karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee har man vasai har sahaje jaataa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and the Lord is easily revealed within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)darahu trisanaa agan bujhee har a(n)mrit sar naataa ||
lines.translation: The fire of desire within is quenched, and one bathes in the Lord's Pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: vadee vadiaaee vade kee guramukh bolaataa ||6||
lines.translation: The great greatness of the great Lord God - the Gurmukh speaks of this. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਪਇਆ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s kiaa preet hai j paiaa hee chhad jaai ||
lines.translation: What love is this between the body and soul, which ends when the body falls?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਿ ਖਵਾਲੀਐ ਜਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: es no kooR bol k khavaaleeai j chaladiaa naal na jaai ||
lines.translation: Why feed it by telling lies? When you leave, it does not go with you.
